messages.subject: estimation errors
parts:
Dear all,

I know that lavaan was not maily meant for prediction of endogeneous variables as an extrapolation process. However, I'm using lavaan to predict environmental variables using deterministic predictors (satellite images, digotal elevation models, etc.). I already fitted the model and applied this code to predict the endogenous properties

##setting up matrices##
B <- inspect(fit3,"est")$beta[1:7,1:7] # matrix of coeff. latent endogenous variables
I <-diag(nrow=7, ncol=7) #Identity matrix
A <- inspect(fit3,"est")$beta[1:7,8:19] #matrix of coeff of exogenous variables

###Prediction model###
library(utils)
pred <- pred[,15:29] #a dataset with NA in Ys and values in Xs

for(i in 1:length(pred[,1])) {
  p=matrix(c(pred$x1[i], pred$x2[i],
             pred$x3[i], pred$x4[i], pred$x5[i], 
             pred$x6[i], pred$x7[i], pred$x8[i],
             pred$x9[i], pred$x10[i], pred$x11[i],
             pred$x12[i]),nrow=12,ncol=1)
  n=c(0,0,0,0,0,0,0)
  n=(solve(I-B))%*%((A%*%p)) ##   η_hat=((I-B)^(-1))∙Γ
  pred$η1[i] <-  n[1]
  pred$η2[i] <-  n[2]
  pred$η3[i] <-  n[3]
  pred$η4[i] <-  n[4]
  pred$η5[i] <-  n[5]
  pred$η6[i] <-  n[6]
  pred$η7[i] <-  n[7]
}

However estimation errors of the model parameter are not taken into account.  I would like to estimate Var(η-η_hat)=...
I would like to know if you could indicate any literature to do it.

Thanks in advance.
Marcos
